entities.summary: The National Institute of Genetics (国立遺伝学研究所) is a Japanese institution founded in 1949. The institute is located in Mishima, Shizuoka. National Institute of Genetics is a research institute in Asia, established in 1949. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
